description: 台灣中油公司家用液化石油氣批售牌價與亞鄰各國比較表 [fuel stations and oil and gas networks] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 台灣中油股份有限公司. 蒐集目的:本國家用液化石油氣批售牌價為亞鄰最低價;資料來源:液化石油氣事業部行銷企劃組依據國外官方網站價格彙總而成. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 台灣中油股份有限公司. Its tags are 開創事業. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-05-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
